atoms.span: an empirical research initiative and framework designed to measure whether persistent identifiers (PIDs)—such as DOIs—actually persist, and to study what happens when scholarly digital objects are removed from institutional or data repositories.
It evaluates how platforms handle metadata after a deletion occurs, specifically evaluating "tombstone" compliance rates (whether a placeholder remains) and the "shape of absence".
For open-source code and dataset specifics, you can view the project directly on the Platform Erosion Observatory GitHub Repository.
